√ruṣ 'be vexed'
present: [1.] roṣati -- [4.] ruṣyati ruṣyate etc. E.+ -- [6.] ruṣati etc. S.+ 
[perfect: ruroṣa aruṣat arūruṣat aroṣīt roṣiṣyati roṣitā roṣṭā ]
verbal: ruṣita E.+ ruṣṭa E.+ ruṣya 
secondary: intensive: roruṣ- -- desiderative: ruruṣiṣa- ruroṣiṣa- -- causative: roṣayati roṣayate etc. E.+ roṣyate E.+ 
derivatives: ruṣ E.+ roṣa E.+ roṣaṇa E.+ roṣin C. 
Occasionally written ruś; and part of the AV. forms of rúśant are referred here by BR.

√rūṣ 'strew'
[present: rūṣati etc. ]
verbal: rūṣita E.+ ruṅṣita 
secondary: causative: rūṣayati roṣayati etc. 
derivatives: rūṣaṇa rūkṣá? V.+
